chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jesu in ama' nungzui sawmlenihte a kiangah samin kha ninte hawlkhiat theih nading ahi-a natna leh zawngkhalna khempeuh damsak theih nading ahi zongin, kha ninte' tungah uktheihna thu amaute guan hi.
Sawltak sawmlenihte a min uh hih bang hi: khatna ah, Peter a kici Simon leh a sanggampa Andrew; Zebedee' tapa James leh a sanggampa John;
Philip leh Bartholomew; Thomas leh siahdong Matthew; Alphaeus' tapa James, leh Thaddaeus;
Gamkhualpa Simon, leh Jesu a lehhekpa Judas Iscariot, ahi hi.
Jesu in hih sawmlenihte sawlkhia-in hih bangin vaikhak hi: “Gentile mite lakah pai kei unla, Samaria mite' khua ah lut kei un.
Israel innsung a mangthang tuute' kiangah paizaw un.
Na pai kawmun, ‘Vantung kumpigam hong nai ta hi,’ ci-in tangko un.
Cinate damsak unla, misite thosak unla, vun natna veite siangsak unla, dawite hawlkhia un. A khawnkhongin na ngah uh, a khawnkhongin pia un.
Kham, ngun, sumngo, cihte na kawnggak sung uhah vom kei un.
Khualzinna ah thung-ip, puantual sungsilh nih, khedap, ciangkhut, cihte zong keng kei un. A hang pen nasemte in an-guai a ngah ding uh kilawm kituak hi.
Khuapi khuata khatpeuh na lut uh ciangin khua sungah zintun nadingin kua kilawm kituak cih beltak kan unla na zinkhiat mateng uh tua takah tungsuak un.
Inn ah na lut uh ciangin inntekte hopih un.
Inntekte kilawm kituak ahihleh nopna lemna thupha na piak uh amau' tungah tung ta hen. Kilawm kituak lo ahihleh na thupha piak uh note' kiangah hong kilehkik ta hen.
Note hong sang lo-in na thugen uh hong ngai lo mi khatpeuh a om leh tua inn tua khua pan na paikhiat uh ciangin na khe uh-a leivui singkhia un.
Maantak kong cihin ah thukhen ni ciangin Sodom leh Gomorrah gamte in tua khua sangin thuaknop sazaw ding uh hi.
“En un, ngiahon laka tuu khah bangin note hong sawlkhia ka hih manin gul bangin pilvang unla, vakhu bangin mawhbaanglo-in om un.
Mite' zia kidawm un. A hang pen mite in thukhen zum ah note hong ap ding uh a, amau' vengkhawm innte ah ciangduai tawh hong sat ding uh hi.
Keima' hangin gam-ukte leh kumpite' mai-ah hong kikai ding a, tuate leh Gentile mite' mai-ah teci na pang ding uh hi.
Tua bangin hong ap uh ciangin bang thu bangci genkhiat ding cih patau kei un. Tua hunlenai ciangin na gen ding uh thu hong kipia ding hi.
A hang pen no a paukhia hilo-in note' tungtawnin note' Pa ii Kha a paukhia hizaw hi.
“Unau khatlekhat ahi zongin, pa in a ta ahi zongin sih nading dong kilehhek ding uh a, tate in nulehpa-te langpanin sihna tun ding uh hi.
Note zong keima' min hangin mi khempeuh in hong mudah ding uh a, ahi zongin a tawp dong a thuakzote in hotkhiatna ngah ding uh hi.
Mite in note khua khat ah hong bawlsiat leh khua dang khat tai un. A hang pen maantak kong cihin ah Israel khuapi khempeuh na khit ma-un Mihing' Tapa hong pai ding hi.
“Nungzui thusin khat a syapa sangin lianzaw lo a, silapa a topa sangin lianzaw lo hi.

Nungzui thusin khat a syapa tawh a kibat leh phazo a, sila khat a topa tawh a kibatleh phazo hi. Tua mite in inntekpa pen ‘Beelzebul’ ci-in sam uh ahihleh ama' innkuanpihte bangzahin mindaisakzaw kan lai ding hiam?
“Tua ahih manin tua mite kihta kei un. A hang pen a kilaakkhia lo dinga kiseelcip thu leh a kitheikhia lo dinga ki-imcip thu, cih bang om lo hi.
Khuamial sunga kong gen thute khuavak sungah gen unla, na bil uh-a kong huau thute innkhum tungah tangko un.
Pumpi a thah uh hangin nunna kha a that theilo tua mite kihta kei un. Nunna kha leh pumpi a nihin hell sungah a susia theipa kihtazaw un.
Gitta nih ciangin assarion tang khat tawh kizuak hilo ahi hiam? Hinapi, na Pa uh' theih lohin tuate khat nangawn lei ah mawk kiat lo hi.
Na lu tung uh-a samzangte nangawn a vekin kisim khin hi.
Tua ahih manin lau kei un; note gitta tampitak sangin na manphazaw uh hi.
“Tua hi a, mite' mai-ah kei hong pulak khempeuh kei zong vantunga om ka Pa' mai-ah ka pulak ding hi.
Ahih hangin mite' mai-ah hong nial peuhpeuh vantunga om ka Pa' mai-ah ka nial ding hi.
“Leitung ah nopna lemna a puak dingin hong pai ci-in hong ngaihsun kei un. Nopna lemna hilo-in namsau a puak ding ka hizaw hi.
A hang pen pasal in a pa, tanu in a nu, mo in a teknu, a langpangsak dingin hong pai ka hi hi.
Mi khat ii galte i cih zong ama' innkuanpihte mah hiding hi.
“Kei sangin a pa ahihkeileh a nu a itzaw peuhpeuh kei tawh kilawm kituak lo a, kei sangin a tapa a tanu a itzaw peuhpeuh kei tawh kilawm kituak lo hi.
Ama' singlamteh pua lo pi-in kei hong zui peuhmah kei tawh kilawm kituak lo hi.
Ama' nuntakna mu-in a ngah mi in tua nuntakna taan ding a, keima' hangin a nuntakna a taan mi in a nuntakna mu-in ngah ding hi.
“No hong sangte kei hong sang hi a, kei hong sangte pen kei hong sawlpa a sang ahi uh hi.
Kamsang khat, kamsang ahihna hangin a sangte in kamsang khat ii ngah pahtakman sang ding uh hi. Midik khat, midik ahihna hangin a sangte in midik khat ii ngah pahtakman sang ding uh hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah hih a neupente khat, nungzui ahihna hangin tuisik hai khat bek hi phial taleh a suah peuhpeuh ama' pahtakman taan peuhmah lo ding hi.”
